_comment: NPU-only target used for every step (decode, verify, prefill): the step is chosen only by the export (frontend/export.py --tokens M --capacity P), never by this file. LP6: four LPDDR6 channels (8 subchannels x 2 ranks, dram-pim configs/LPDDR6_PIM_Mobile_4CH.ini), NPU 4 cores at 800 MHz, run with the 4-core simulator settings. Optimizations have no switches: every pass runs, and whether a rewrite applies to an op is decided from the tensor shapes and the hardware numbers below (include/npu/Decode/Transforms/NpuCost.h); every such choice is listed in io.json phases[].decisions. Hardware numbers: l1_*_bytes_per_cycle (32 banks x 4 B), mma_k_per_cycle and mma_pipeline_cycles (INT8 matrix timing), vector_* (VPU lanes and shared SFUs) are the simulator's settings (docs/architecture/NPU_SIMULATOR.md); gdma_read_gbps is the sustained LP6 read of a Qwen3-4B program replayed without compute (92.9 GB/s, 2026-10-31); core_split_us is the fixed cost of running one op on 4 cores instead of 1, measured on Qwen3-4B one-layer fixtures (M = 1, 4, 8, every op split vs none, 2026-10-31). The pim values, lp6_read_gbps and gemv_fixed_us are the cost model of hyb-partition and are not used with --force=npu. Measurements: workspace docs/research/NPU_ONLY_BASELINE.md.
